connectorUiConfig.title: QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay data connector ingests tunnel telemetry from hybrid post-quantum WireGuard instances into Microsoft Sentinel through the QCrypton API. PQC VPN Overlay extends WireGuard with ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 digital signatures, providing quantum-resistant tunnels with backward compatibility. This connector streams tunnel lifecycle events, policy enforcement decisions, classical fallback warnings, and HNDL risk indicators into the PQCVPNOverlay_CL table.

graphQueries.metricName: Total VPN tunnel telemetry events received

sampleQueries.description: PQC tunnel adoption rate in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize PQC = countif(PQCUsed == 1), Classical = countif(PQCUsed == 0)
| extend PQCPct = round(100.0 * PQC / (PQC + Classical), 1)
| project PQC, Classical, PQCPct

PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType == 'policy_block'
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID, PeerAddress, KeyExchange, PolicyMode, ErrorMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: HNDL risk assessment across active tunnels
sampleQueries.query:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType == 'tunnel_up'
| summarize Protected = countif(HNDLRisk == 0), AtRisk = countif(HNDLRisk == 1) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| render timechart

PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where EventType == 'classical_fallback'
| project TimeGenerated, PeerID, PeerAddress, KeyExchange, PolicyMode, HNDLRisk
| order by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: PQCVPNOverlay_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQCVPNOverlay_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Connect QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay to Microsoft Sentinel

parameters.content: This connector polls the QCrypton PQC VPN Overlay API to retrieve hybrid post-quantum WireGuard tunnel telemetry and ingest it into the **PQCVPNOverlay_CL** table in your Log Analytics workspace.

#### 1. API Key
Obtain your QCrypton API key (starts with `qk-`) from the [QCrypton Portal](https://portal.qcrypton.com). Navigate to **Settings > API Keys** and generate a key with read access to VPN tunnel telemetry.

#### 2. API Server URL
Enter the base URL of your QCrypton API server. The default is `https://api.qcrypton.com`. If you use a dedicated or regional instance, enter the URL provided by QCrypton.

parameters.label: QCrypton API Server URL
parameters.name: apiServerUrl
parameters.description: Enter the QCrypton API base URL. Do not include a trailing slash or path.
